intent: A creator comparing two batches, or a batch with its skill withheld, is told whether the difference supports calling the change better, instead of reading a mean and an interval and deciding alone.
observable_outcome: GET comparison and the batch report's skill_effect carry a verdict; the page shows it first, and a difference whose 95% interval includes zero is shown as no clear difference.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The verdict is improved or worse when the 99.9% interval excludes zero, likely improved or likely worse when only the 95% interval does, and no clear difference when the 95% interval includes zero.
Fewer than two pairs give the verdict too few pairs, with the difference but no interval.
A comparison whose 95% interval includes zero answers verdict no_clear_difference.
